title: StitchVector POC-01 pre-registration (written and pushed BEFORE any experiment run)

inputs.rule: deterministic centre crop; images read as decoded 8-bit RGB; no labels used for generation, quantization or repair
inputs.labels: 13014 official labels may be used ONLY in a separate offline diagnostic after all runs; never inside generation

rendering_for_evaluation.raster_back: rasterio.features.rasterize, all_touched=False (pixel-centre rule), identity affine in pixel coordinates (x right, y down), no anti-aliasing
rendering_for_evaluation.paint_order: features drawn in ascending z (z stored as attribute); later overwrites earlier
rendering_for_evaluation.svg_route: SVG paths are flattened to polygons (cubics sampled, 8 points per segment), transforms applied, then rasterized by the same rule; this is our measured renderer, not a browser renderer

fidelity_definitions.vs_quantized: pixel match against the quantized image the method was given (intermediate target)
fidelity_definitions.vs_original: pixel match against the original decoded RGB crop (final target)
metrics: boundary distance: symmetric mean distance between Canny edges of original and render
thin-structure match: share of pixels in the thin mask that are within dE<=10 after rendering
fidelity_definitions.thin_mask: pixels whose local inscribed width in their same-quantized-colour component is <= 3 px (EDT <= 1.5) using the 32-colour quantization; label-free, fixed before runs
fidelity_definitions.rule: vs_quantized success is never reported as lossless vs the original

R0.method: joint RGB key = R*65536+G*256+B; rasterio.features.shapes (4-connectivity) -> one polygon per same-colour component; written to GPKG
R0.pass: rasterise_back equals original exactly (100% of pixels) on all 6 small samples
R0.resource_guard: abort a sample if > 4 GB RSS or > 600 s; report and continue
R0.not_scaled_up: full 1000x1000 R0 is not run; GSJ object count is already known (~997k per Mpx)

R1.quantization: PIL Image.quantize(method=MEDIANCUT, dither=NONE); palette passed to vtracer as fixed --palette

configs.name: default
configs.note: vtracer defaults (stacked, speckle 4, precision 6) as the out-of-the-box reference

R1.raw_RGB_only_extra: the 'default' and 'watershed' (clustering=watershed, watershed_detail=128) configs are also run on raw RGB
R1.grid: every input x every config, each once

R2.base: quantized label image (16/32/64, same quantization as R1)

layers.variant_A_direct: no line/fill separation: all colours traced as a planar mosaic
layers.variant_B_layered: dark ink class (palette colour with L* < 35 in CIELab) separated; ink pixels reassigned to the majority non-ink colour among 8-neighbours iteratively (fill completion); reassigned pixels flagged inferred=1; ink drawn as a separate upper layer (z above fills)

progressive.stage_1: polygonize the label image (rasterio shapes), simplify every ring with shared-boundary-preserving simplification (topology preserved on the edge graph: shared arcs simplified once) at tolerance 4 px
progressive.residual: rasterize the current planar partition; residual = pixels whose label differs from the target label image; 4-connected residual blocks
progressive.repair: for each residual block: take the union of the features it overlaps, cut the block mask out of them (geometric difference), re-polygonize the target labels inside the block, simplify at the next tolerance, and insert; result must remain a non-overlapping planar partition
progressive.accept: a repair is kept only if exact label error inside the block strictly decreases; otherwise reverted
progressive.fallback: after stage 1 px, remaining residual blocks are inserted as exact pixel polygons (tolerance 0)
progressive.no_size_filter: no residual block is discarded for being small; no edge-zone exclusion

R2.fair_comparison: R2 is compared with R1 and with single-pass tolerance-1 and tolerance-0 traces of the same label image (same input, same palette, same evaluation)

automatic_tests_before_runs: R0 synthetic: random 8-colour 64x64 image -> polygons -> raster equals input
planar partition: after every repair step, union area == window area, pairwise overlap area == 0 (shapely), no gaps
repair replaces: feature count after repair == count before - removed + inserted (traceable ids)
holes and paint order: synthetic ring-with-hole and nested colours round-trip exactly
GPKG round trip: write -> read -> rasterize equals in-memory rasterization

reporting.pareto: fidelity_vs_original (exact share and dE90) against vertices, per sample
reporting.thin_structures: thin-mask match reported separately for every run

decision_rules.R0: PASS iff 100% exact round trip on all 6 small samples
decision_rules.R2_worth_building: R2 is worth further development iff, on at least 2 of 3 samples, at equal or better vs_original exact share AND equal or better thin-mask match, R2 uses <= 0.75x the vertices of the best R1 run at that fidelity (Pareto comparison). Otherwise report that single-pass tracing is sufficient.

limits: no training; no M1/M2/B2/RAG change; no sealed test pool; no 08011/08021; no main merge; QGIS editing (P3) not in this run
